creativity.description: Increase or decrease AI's creativity. Valid values range [-10, 10], default 0.
creativity.title: Creativity

engine.description: Magnific model engines. automatic - default choice, magnific_illusio - for smoother illustrations, magnific_sharpy - better for realistic images, magnific_sparkle - middle ground between Illusio and Sharpy.
engine.title: Engine

fractality.description: Control the strength of the prompt and intricacy per square pixel. Valid values range [-10, 10], default 0.
fractality.title: Fractality

hdr.description: Increase or decrease the level of definition and detail. Valid values range [-10, 10], default 0.
hdr.title: HDR

optimized_for.description: Styles to optimize the upscale process.
optimized_for.title: Optimized For

resemblance.description: Adjust the level of resemblance to the original image. Valid values range [-10, 10], default 0.
resemblance.title: Resemblance

scale_factor.description: Configure scale factor of the image. For higher scales, the image will take longer to process.
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor
